goal: Demonstrate a bounded technical-disclosure workflow using only the explicitly fictional input brief. Organize source-stated features and unknowns, prepare a draft disclosure and tentative claim outline, then ask a separate child to map each claim feature to its supplied or proposed support. Any literature or patent search remains a plan because this campaign has no search capability. Label every output as a fictional workflow demonstration, not a novelty conclusion, legal opinion or filing-ready invention. Preserve missing experiments and measurements as gaps.
